**Finding submitted: deviation (partial compliance).**

- **What exists (in our favour):** Section 8.1 gives us Commerce One's IP infringement indemnity for the Software, covering defence, damages and reasonable attorneys' fees, with a standard notice/tender-of-control/cooperation procedure and procure–modify/replace–terminate-and-refund remedies. Section 8.2 carries only the usual exclusions (use outside Documentation; third-party modification). Section 9 expressly excepts Section 8 liability from both the 12-month fee cap and the consequential-damages waiver, so the Vendor indemnity is uncapped — better than our fallback super-cap.
- **What is missing:** No Vendor indemnity for Commerce One's breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of our or our Customers' data, or its gross negligence or wilful misconduct. There is no reciprocal Corio indemnity anywhere in the document, so nothing needed narrowing on our side.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New Section 8.3 adding those three limbs, expressly importing the Section 8.1 procedure and confirming the IP-specific Section 8.2 exclusions do not apply to them. Fallback offered in the comment if Commerce One resists.
